concerns.text: Task T004 references a verification step ‘Verify presence of all 19 variables per species; exit with code 1 on any missing file.’ but FR‑001/FR‑002 require *all* predictor variables for every record. The task does not guarantee that the 19 variables are present for *every* occurrence point, only that files exist, weakening the functional requirement.

Task T004 is marked as incomplete in the analysis report (occurrence CSVs for 1970‑2000 and 2005‑2020 are missing and climate rasters are not downloaded), leaving FR‑001, FR‑002, and the climate‑data requirements uncovered.

T005 assumes the existence of the occurrence files produced by T004; because T004 is incomplete, T005 cannot compute data‑sufficiency or perform the power‑analysis gate, violating FR‑006, FR‑011 and the associated success criteria.
The GPU‑check script and its invocation are missing, so the CPU‑only constraint (FR‑004) is not enforced. This is a direct violation of the functional requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – Projection, evaluation & statistical inference (T008) step 3
concerns.text: FR‑009 requires reporting *delta AUC/TSS* for niche stability, yet T008 computes ‘Delta suitability’ (mean suitability difference) instead, weakening the required metric.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – Projection, evaluation & statistical inference (T008) step 4
concerns.text: FR‑010 mandates hierarchical bootstrap on performance metrics (AUC/TSS). The task performs the bootstrap on ‘delta suitability’, not on the required metrics, violating the specification.

T012 introduces a bias‑correction script that is not mentioned in the spec. Adding un‑specified functionality constitutes silent scope creep and breaches the constitution’s principle of avoiding undocumented changes.
